qualifier: endosome, phagosome and autophagosome cargo routes
name: Lysosome fusion with endosomes, phagosomes and autophagosomes
rationale: All members concern late endocytic, phagocytic or autophagic compartments fusing with or delivering to the lysosome/vacuole, unlike confusables centred on autophagosome assembly regulation, selective autophagy or Golgi-to-lysosome biogenesis.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and endocytic downregulation
qualifier: MET and PTK6 signaling with ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis
name: MET and PTK6 signaling with receptor endocytic downregulation
rationale: Members cover HGF/MET receptor activation and effectors, PTK6 signaling and ubiquitin/ESCRT-mediated endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB4, whereas confusables are dominated by ERBB adaptor and PI3K/AKT events lacking MET, PTK6 and receptor degradation.

qualifier: IRS-AKT2 axis, glycogen synthesis and signal attenuation
name: Insulin receptor-IRS-AKT2 signaling and its attenuation
rationale: All members regulate insulin signaling through IRS and AKT2 to glycogen synthesis and glucose import, including feedback attenuation, distinguishing it from confusables built on adiponectin, glucagon or generic PI3K/AKT and IGF1R signaling.

qualifier: with carnitine synthesis and shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketogenesis
rationale: Members cover acyl-CoA beta-oxidation cycles, carnitine synthesis and transport, and ketone body synthesis and use, whereas confusables centre on branched-chain amino acid catabolism, TCA/PDH cofactors or fatty acid membrane transport.

qualifier: atypical ubiquitin chain linkages and ISG15
name: Atypical ubiquitin chain and ISG15 conjugation in antiviral defense
rationale: Members combine non-K48/K63 ubiquitin chain assembly (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free chains) with interferon-induced ISG15 conjugation restricting viruses, while confusables are deubiquitinase sets or viral replication modulation.

core: Lipid second messenger signaling through PLC, PI3K and PKC
qualifier: downstream of B cell receptor and G-protein-coupled receptors
name: PLC-PI3K-PKC lipid second messenger signaling from BCR and GPCRs
rationale: Members generate and act on phosphoinositide-derived messengers (PLC, PI3K-gamma, PKC, Ca2+) from BCR, G beta:gamma, S1P/LPA receptors and VEGFR2, distinguishing it from confusables focused on calcium/ionomycin responses, Fc-gamma phagocytosis or BCR regulation by CD22.

qualifier: deubiquitinase families and chain-specific deubiquitination
name: Deubiquitinase-mediated ubiquitin editing in TNFR1-NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members pair deubiquitinase families and K11/K48/K63/linear chain control with TNFR1 and NF-kappaB regulation, whereas confusables cover TLR, NOD, TCR and non-canonical NF-kappaB kinase cascades without the DUB machinery.

core: IL-6 family cytokine signaling via STAT3
qualifier: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 with ERK activation
name: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: All members concern IL-6 and the IL-27/IL-35 heterodimeric cytokines signaling through JAK-STAT3 and ERK1/2, distinguishing it from confusables built on common-gamma-chain cytokines or CNTF/LIF/IL-11 gp130 ligands.

qualifier: cohesion, chiasma assembly and chromosome alignment
name: Meiotic chromosome cohesion, chiasma formation and segregation
rationale: Members cover the mechanics of meiotic chromosomes (sister cohesion, chiasmata, alignment, movement to poles), whereas confusables cover meiotic checkpoint and phase-transition regulation or mitotic cohesion.

qualifier: malate-aspartate shuttle
name: TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle and pyruvate metabolism
rationale: Members link TCA intermediates (2-oxoglutarate, malate, oxaloacetate), the malate-aspartate shuttle and pyruvate transport/turnover, distinguishing it from confusables on amino acid nitrogen metabolism, PDH/CoA, carboxylate transporters or respiratory chain.

core: Cellular response to peroxide and nitrosative stress
qualifier: HMOX1-BACH1 regulation and oxidative apoptosis control
name: Peroxide and nitric oxide stress responses with HMOX1-BACH1 regulation
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide and nitric oxide/nitrosative stress with HMOX1-BACH1 control and oxidative-stress apoptosis, while confusables emphasise ROS detoxification, hypoxia or ferroptosis.

qualifier: cGAMP-STING and dendritic cell CCL5 output
name: cGAMP-STING-driven dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
rationale: Members concern cGAMP import and STING enhancement together with dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5/STAT6 chemokine production, distinguishing it from macrophage chemokine, interferon response or IRF3/type I IFN confusables.

qualifier: aquaporin and inositol transport with paracellular flux
name: Water, inositol and magnesium transport across membranes and epithelia
rationale: Members centre on passive transport of water, inositol, magnesium and lipids via aquaporins, inositol transporters and claudin-type paracellular routes (coherence is loose), whereas confusables emphasise chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and tight-junction or magnesium homeostasis.

core: Apical membrane transport and lipid translocation
qualifier: canalicular ABCB4/ABCB11 bile transport
name: Apical membrane lipid translocation and canalicular bile transport
rationale: Members cover apical/raft protein localisation, phospholipid and sphingolipid flipping and ABCB4/ABCB11/CFTR apical transporters for bile secretion, unlike confusables on CFTR trafficking, epithelial water transport or scramblase and vesicle traffic modules.

qualifier: NOXA and PUMA
name: NOXA and PUMA BH3-only activation driving cytochrome c release
rationale: Members describe NOXA/PUMA activation, BH3-only inactivation of anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins and cytochrome c release, distinguishing it from confusables on BAD/BIM/BID/BAX/BAK and apoptosome steps or p53 transcriptional control.

qualifier: lysophospholipid receptors and phosphoinositide-PLC signaling
name: Lysophospholipid receptor and phosphoinositide-PLC signaling
rationale: The three members (S1P/LPA receptors, PLC-gamma-driven VEGFR2 proliferation, phosphatidylinositol synthesis regulation) share only a loose phospholipid-messenger signaling thread, but it is clearly distinct from the coagulation, endocannabinoid, eicosanoid and vitamin K confusables.

qualifier: oncogene-induced, with senescence-associated heterochromatin
name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescence-associated heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members cover oncogene-induced senescence, SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and regulation of senescence and proliferative arrest, whereas confusables emphasise SASP, oxidative or replicative senescence and p53-driven apoptosis.

qualifier: methionine synthase (MTR/MTRR) remethylation
name: Methionine synthase cycle and sulfur amino acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern methionine and sulfur/aspartate-family amino acid synthesis and MTR/MTRR defects, distinguishing it from folate, cobalamin and S-adenosylmethionine/choline confusables.

qualifier: CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG
name: CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the CDC42-subfamily and RHOG GTPase cycles plus small GTPase signaling, distinguishing it from confusables built on RAC1-3, RHOA-C or RHOD/U/V.

qualifier: PLC-gamma, GAB1 and GRB7 recruitment
name: EGFR-ERBB2 adaptor signaling including PLC-gamma, GAB1 and GRB7
rationale: Members are effector/adaptor events of EGFR and ERBB2 (GRB2, SHC1, PI3K, PLC-gamma, GAB1, GRB7, motility), while confusables lack the PLC-gamma, GAB1 and GRB7 arms and add ERBB3/ERBB4 or transactivation.

core: Kinase inhibitor resistance of oncogenic receptor mutants
qualifier: FLT3
name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of FLT3 mutants
rationale: Every member describes FLT3 mutant binding of or resistance to a specific TKI, distinguishing it from confusables on ALK, KIT, PDGFR or FGFR mutants and FLT3 downstream signaling.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and contact-site lipid transfer
name: ER tubule shaping, fusion and contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER-plasma membrane tethering and lipid/cholesterol transfer, distinguishing it from confusables on ER-mitochondria tethering or phosphoinositide synthesis.

qualifier: integrin interactions and fibronectin matrix assembly
name: Integrin-extracellular matrix adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members are ECM gene modules, integrin surface interactions, collagen receptor signaling and fibronectin matrix formation, whereas confusables focus on EMT/fibroblast programmes, collagen fibril and elastic fibre assembly, or MMP-driven matrix degradation.

core: APC/C ubiquitin ligase regulation at mitotic exit
qualifier: Emi1 phosphorylation and degradation
name: APC/C regulation through Emi1 degradation and Cdh1 targeting
rationale: Members regulate anaphase-promoting complex activity across metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit, including Emi1 phosphorylation/SCF degradation and Cdh1 targets, which the APC/C:Cdc20 and APC/C phosphorylation confusables lack.

qualifier: MutS/MLH1 defects
name: DNA mismatch repair and its MutS-MLH1 defects
rationale: All members concern MutS-alpha/beta-directed mismatch repair and disease-associated MLH1/MSH2/MSH3/MSH6 defects, while confusables cover double-strand break, cross-link and repair synthesis processes.
